# AuraLink Digital Agency

> AuraLink Digital Agency provides website development, e-commerce websites, custom software, AI agents, and business automation solutions for businesses in India and worldwide.

## Core Services

- **Website Development**: Business websites, local business websites, e-commerce stores, website redesigns, and premium 3D websites.
- **AI Agents & Automation**: Voice calling agents, WhatsApp business agents, sales agents, lead generation and qualification agents, onboarding automation, and workflow automation.
- **Custom Software Development**: Web applications, mobile applications, SaaS platforms, CRM systems, ERP systems, internal business tools, and AI-powered platforms.
- **Technical SEO**: Technical SEO, metadata, structured data, sitemap implementation, performance optimization, and search-engine-friendly website architecture.
